verdict.rationale: Docs confirm broad provider-agnostic design: native Ollama support, OpenAI-compatible APIs with custom Base URL (covering OpenRouter, Groq, vLLM, LM Studio, etc.), and per-conversation/per-model switching via the model sidebar and side-by-side comparison feature. However, the pack never explicitly confirms native Anthropic or Google (Gemini) integrations — these would presumably need custom Functions/Pipes rather than being named as first-class providers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of native Anthropic and Google provider support, and any per-agent (not just per-conversation) model-switching workflow beyond the sidebar selector.
